prompt: pacemaker colocation constraint resource template rsc with-rsc restriction
answer:
A resource template can be referenced in a Pacemaker colocation constraint. It represents **all primitive resources derived from that template**, so the constraint applies to every one of them.

Example:

```xml
<rsc_colocation id="vm-template-colo-base-rsc"
                rsc="vm-template"
                rsc-role="Started"
                with-rsc="base-rsc"
                score="INFINITY"/>
```

This colocates all resources derived from `vm-template` with `base-rsc`.

Restriction: in a colocation constraint, **only one template may be referenced**, and it must be specified in either `rsc` or `with-rsc`; the other attribute must reference a regular resource. Templates can also be used in order and `rsc_ticket` constraints.
